name: eth_ucy_five_location_loso
validation_policy: By default all four non-test locations are used for fitting and no validation split is created. Optional grouped validation selects one entire eligible non-test scene_sequence deterministically from data_seed and removes it from training.
policy: For each fold, test is the named held-out location and fitting uses the other four benchmark locations. Optional grouped validation can reserve one complete non-test scene_sequence. arxiepiskopi1, crowds_zara03, and uni_examples are canonical UCY sequences that are converted and included in publication/statistics characterization; they are excluded only from this five-fold forecasting benchmark's training, validation, and evaluation.
